question: Should this PR wait for inspectable after-fix source-channel proof, or may maintainers accept the prompt-only and focused-test evidence for this `message_tool_only` delivery fix?
rationale: The code path looks like the narrow owner-boundary fix, but the external PR proof is not inspectable in this review and the automated Mantis proof failed.

options.title: Request Inspectable Proof
options.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor adds a redacted recording, contact sheet, logs, or successful Mantis artifact showing tool work before the final current-source message.

options.title: Accept Prompt-Only Risk
options.body: Merge on the instruction, unit assertion, snapshots, and CI while explicitly accepting that real transport behavior was not independently verified.

recommendation.title: Request Inspectable Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until the contributor adds a redacted recording, contact sheet, logs, or successful Mantis artifact showing tool work before the final current-source message.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a proof gate for the Codex app-server source-reply path, and current-line/history evidence routes that area most strongly to this owner candidate.
